title: Ethersphere systems have been compromised, leading to the distribution of malicious versions of bee-js (13.3.0) and Swarm Desktop (0.56.2).
content_md:
Ethersphere systems have been compromised, leading to the distribution of malicious versions of bee-js (13.3.0) and Swarm Desktop (0.56.2). 

via Mastodon https://en.hacks.gr/prosochi-molysmenes-ekdoseis-sta-bee-js-kai-swarm-desktop-klevoyn-dedomena/
